title: Administrador(a) SalesForce Pleno
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Oportunidade para: Administrador(a) SalesForce Pleno


Experiência inicial com Salesforce (ideal 6 meses a 2 anos como Admin, suporte ou função similar).

Vivência ou interesse em trabalhar em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e com times multidisciplinares.


Experiência com atendimento a usuários, suporte funcional e organização de demandas.

Desejável: participação em projetos de implantação ou melhorias em Salesforce.

Conhecimentos em configuração de Salesforce: Object Manager, Setup, Security Model, Flows.

Noções de Data Management: import/export (Data Import Wizard / Data Loader), qualidade e governança de dados.


Noções de ambientes e ciclo de mudanças: Sandboxes, Change Sets (ou SFDX como diferencial).

Desejável: noções de integrações (APIs), troubleshooting básico e leitura de logs/erros.


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto e CLT


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Tech Lead
description:
To work in 6 months remote Project we are looking for a bilindual Commerce Tech Lead or Architect .


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering; 3–5+ years in a senior/lead/architect role.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with CommerceTools . Adobe Commerce is a Plus.
  • Deep understanding of headless commerce , MACH architecture , GraphQL , and event-driven systems .
  • Proven experience building social media commerce integrations (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, etc.).
  • Solid experience with Node.js , Java , or TypeScript .
  • Experience designing integrations via REST APIs, GraphQL, event brokers (Kafka, SNS/SQS), and webhooks.
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with frontend frameworks (Next.js, React, Vue) in headless architectures.
  • Experience with PIM/DAM (Salisfy, Contentful, Adobe).
  • Prior involvement in large-scale B2C or B2B commerce replatforming.
  • Familiarity with marketplace or social-commerce ecosystems.
  • MACH Alliance certification or similar credentials.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Do you have 2+ years of experience recruiting developers?


Want to have flexible work hours and make $1,000 to $2,000 per month?


Recruiters at our company use our unique AI technology to source and analyze software developers for top-paying jobs around the World.


This is a Full Time job - NO part-time workers - but you can choose your hours (but once daily, a 30-minute huddle is mandatory).


Compensation:

  • Total compensation: $1,000–$2,000/month (base plus commissions).
  • 100% Remote
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)


Requirements:

  • Conversational English
  • 2+ years of experience as a Sourcer or Recruiter


Applications will ONLY be considered if you submit a 60-second introduction video answering the following question:

  • What's the most challenging problem you had at work, and how did you solve it?


Submit your video here: 


*Only our most Senior HR Manager will watch your video and delete it afterward. We review 100% of the videos submitted.

title: Senior Property Manager
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for an experienced Senior Property Manager to oversee operations, lead a team of junior property managers, and ensure smooth day-to-day management of residential and/or commercial properties. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of U.S. property management, proven leadership skills, and the ability to balance tenant relations, administrative efficiency, and team management in a fast-paced environment.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead, mentor, and provide guidance to junior on-site property managers, ensuring best practices are followed across the team
  • Oversee tenant communications, lease renewals, and resolution of escalated tenant issues
  • Assist in managing leasing activities, including advertising, coordinating with your on-site team for property showings, applicant screening, and drafting lease agreements
  • Ensure compliance with lease terms, investigate violations, and address tenant disputes professionally
  • Supervise vendor coordination for maintenance repairs and upgrades, and coordinate with the on-site property manager for larger renovation projects
  • Collaborate with leadership on property marketing strategies and operational improvements
  • Oversee properties’ financial performance, including drafting budgets, tracking actuals to budget, and dictating strategies to maximize financial outcomes


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong background in U.S. residential and/or commercial property management (required)
  • Previous experience managing or leading a property management team
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software



Why You’ll Love Working Here:


Competitive Compensation

We offer a competitive monthly salary of USD 1,500 - 2,500, based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Consultor SAP FI Sênior
description:
Consultor SAP FI Sênior – Fluxo de Caixa


A Plus IT está em busca de um Consultor SAP FI Sênior , com forte atuação em Fluxo de Caixa , para participar de um projeto estratégico de manutenção e melhorias em um cliente do setor de Utilities.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como consultor sênior no módulo SAP FI , com foco em Fluxo de Caixa ;
  • Analisar, mapear e otimizar processos financeiros relacionados a caixa e liquidez ;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Propor melhorias, correções e soluções técnicas e funcionais .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida como Consultor SAP FI ;
  • Especialização comprovada em Fluxo de Caixa ;
  • Experiência com SAP Cash & Liquidity Management (CLM) , incluindo fluxo de caixa previsto e realizado .

title: Data Scientist \"987402\"
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver, treinar e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio, utilizando linguagens como Python ou R.

Realizar modelagem de dados, estruturando e preparando bases de dados para análises avançadas e para consumo por modelos estatísticos e preditivos.

Extrair, manipular e analisar dados utilizando SQL, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance nas consultas.

Avaliar, validar e monitorar o desempenho dos modelos em produção, aplicando métricas estatísticas e ajustes contínuos para melhoria de resultados.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas, documentando processos, hipóteses e resultados de forma clara e acessível.


O que você precisa ter


  • Python ou R;
  • SQL;
  • Pytorch.

Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Oportunidade para: Desenvolvedor(a) SalesForce Sênior


Experiência sólida (nível sênior) em projetos Salesforce, atuando como desenvolvedor(a) por no mínimo 4 anos (ou equivalente).


Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD.


certificações Salesforce.

100% remoto e CLT e PJ


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration


  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration


  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

title: Solutions Architect | Senior
description:
Na Compass UOL, somos movidos por inovação, autonomia e crescimento contínuo. Aqui, você será parte de uma empresa global que transforma negócios por meio de tecnologia e inovação, criando soluções de alto impacto para alguns dos maiores players do mercado.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir arquiteturas AWS alinhadas às necessidades da plataforma;
  • Projetar soluções baseadas em microserviços e APIs;
  • Estabelecer padrões de segurança, autenticação e autorização;
  • Arquitetar fluxos de identidade utilizando IDPs corporativos;
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de Agentic AI, incluindo agentes, orquestração, memória e integração com sistemas internos;
  • Definir o uso de gateways de agentes para controle, observabilidade e segurança;
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos, custo e impacto operacional;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de DevOps e Desenvolvimento.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência com Agentic AI e sistemas multiagentes;
  • Conhecimento em AgentCore Gateway;
  • Familiaridade com Foundation Models, MCPs e LLMs;
  • Vivência em plataformas digitais de alto volume;
  • Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas cloud-native;
  • Experiência em desenho de soluções escaláveis e seguras baseadas em microserviços;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de segurança, autenticação e autorização;
  • Experiência com integração de identidade digital e IDPs corporativos.


Não possui todos os requisitos para a vaga?


Está tudo bem! Na Compass UOL, estimulamos o desenvolvimento contínuo de novos talentos e transformamos desafios em oportunidades.

title: Vendedor(a)
description:
Com foco em inovação e excelência em nossas operações, buscamos profissionais apaixonados e apaixonadas por vendas e atendimento aos clientes para se juntar à nossa equipe e desfrutar de um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, desafiador e gratificante, que proporciona grandes oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e financeiro.

Responsabilidades:

Televendas ativo de materiais elétricos, hidráulicos, itens para MRO, iluminação, automação elétrica industrial, EPI's, linha contra incêndio, entre outros, para clientes corporativos (PJ), como construtoras, incorporadoras, indústrias, engenharias, estabelecimentos comerciais, etc.

Prospecção de clientes, captação, reativação, acompanhamento e pós-venda.

Análise de mercado, da posição e das necessidades dos clientes, identificação de oportunidades de negócios;

Foco no atendimento aos clientes e na estratégia de resultados

Requisitos:

Experiência com venda ativa por telefone, prospecção e reativação de clientes, acompanhamento e pós-venda, negociação e técnicas de atendimento e vendas à clientes corporativos.

Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de persuasão e negociação estratégica;

Boa capacidade de organização, de atenção e proatividade;

Foco no cliente


Remuneração atrativa composta por salário fixo + comissionamento + premiação + VT + VR/VA + Assist. Médica + Assist. Odontológica + Seguro de Vida + Auxílio-Educação


Trabalho presencial (Porto Alegre), de segunda a sexta, horário comercial.

title: Científico de datos
description:
We’re Hiring | Data Scientist (Remote – Full Time)

Staffing Abroad is currently looking for a Data Scientist for one of our U.S.-based clients in the digital assets and FinTech space. In this role, you’ll transform complex datasets into predictive insights that drive strategy, growth, and performance across Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Operations.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and deploy machine learning and predictive models for revenue forecasting and business optimization
  • Perform statistical analysis, feature engineering, and A/B testing
  • Develop dashboards and insights using Domo for executive decision-making
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Finance, and Marketing teams
  • Explore and prototype AI/ML innovations, including LLMs and generative AI.


Tech Stack:

Snowflake must | Rivery | dbt | Domo or similar | Python expert level | SQL expert level


What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning
  • Strong skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred)
  • Background in FinTech, SaaS, or data-driven environments is a plus
  • Strong business mindset and data storytelling skills
  • Advanced English level (C1) required


Why apply?

  • 100% remote role
  • Competitive compensation with bonus eligibility
  • High-impact, data-driven projects
  • Collaborative and fast-paced work environment
  • Payment in USD


Interested or know someone who might be a great fit?

Feel free to apply or reach out directly.

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Groovy Pleno
description:
Estamos procurando por alguém que goste de trabalhar com tecnologia, tenham facilidade em aprender e que tenha experiência sólida em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.

Se você é esse tipo desenvolvedor, queremos te conhecer!

Somos um lugar de inovação, por isso é muito importante ter em nosso time pessoas que gostem de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento.


Vem crescer com a gente!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como desenvolvedor Pleno você será responsável pelo:

* Desenvolvimento de componentes e páginas para os nossos produtos;

* Desenvolvimento de API's Restful;

* Revisão e garantia de qualidade de código e padrões da equipe de desenvolvimento;

* Criação de queries e scripts SQL;

* Desenvolvimento backend, front-end e testes unitários;

* Discussão em propostas de solução;

* Trabalhar em ambiente Linux para desenvolvimento;

* Vivência em práticas, técnicas e metodologias ágeis;

* Realizar versionamento de código com Git;

* Quando necessário, participar também de reuniões com stakeholders para levantamento de requisitos;

* Realizar apresentações de evolução e resultados para outros desenvolvedores e demais integrantes da equipe.


Requisitos e qualificações

Os requisitos abaixo são muito importantes para atuação como Desenvolvedor em nossos times.

* Saber analisar e resolver problemas;

* Ter boa lógica de programação;

* Dominar estrutura de dados e algoritmos;

* Conhecimento em HTML, CSS, JavaScript;

* Conhecimento de Design System e componentes reutilizáveis;

* Domínio de alguma linguagem orientada a objetos, preferencialmente Java ou Groovy;

* Saber fazer consultas complexas em Bancos de dados Relacional (SGBD);

Conhecimentos desejáveis, mas não eliminatórios

* Algum framework de backend (Grails, Spring ou Spring Boot, Hibernate, Micronaut, etc.);

* TypeScript;

* Elastic Stack - ElasticSearch/Kibana;

* Continuous Integration (CI);

* Container (Docker, kubernetes, etc.);

* Arquitetura orientada a serviços;

* Mensageria e Stream de dados (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.);

* Boas práticas de desenvolvimento como TDD e Design Patterns;


Informações adicionais

* Cartão flexível de Vale Alimentação e Refeição;

* Vale Transporte;

* Plano de Saúde;

* Plano Odontológico;

* Auxílio Home office

* Ginastica Laboral;

* Day off aniversário;

* Wellnes hub;

* Acesso à plataforma Zenklub, uma rede com mais de 150 especialistas em saúde mental;

* Convênio com Instituições de Ensino: IPOG e WiseUp;

* Eventos de Integração (Meetups, Workshop, Maratonas e Festas);

* Aprendizado Constante somado a Oportunidade de crescimento;

* Ótimo ambiente de trabalho.


Nossas equipes possuem autonomia para correr atrás de seus resultados.


Tecnologia e Inovação fazem parte da nossa essência.

title: Content Operations Manager
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support 1,000+ providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.



What You Will Do



Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings



Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

title: Data Analyst
description:
To work in 6 months remote Project we are looking for a bilingual Data Analyst


The ideal candidate will use their passion for data analytics to provide insights to the business covering a range of topics. They will be responsible for conducting both recurring and ad hoc analysis for business users.


Responsibilities

  • Understand the day-to-day issues that our business faces, which can be better understood with data
  • Compile and analyze data related to business' issues
  • Develop clear visualizations to convey complicated data in a straightforward fashion


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics or Applied Mathematics or equivalent experience
  • +5 years' Data Analysis experience
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Proficent in Python
  • Able to work on assigned data with minimal daily input from client
  • Manipulate raw data sources to generate business insights, ideally that can be turned to predictive AI in a later project.

title: Staff Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Angular)
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos buscando um Senior Full Stack Engineer Java para atuar diretamente no time de nosso cliente localizado na Nova Zelândia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de uma aplicação SaaS em um ambiente de equipe colaborativa e multifuncional.


Horário de Trabalho:

É necessário disponibilidade para comunicação com o time do cliente entre 18h e 22h (BRT) - Segunda a Quinta-feira BRT .


Requisito Obrigatório:

Inglês fluente para comunicação verbal e escrita com equipes internacionais.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolver e manter uma aplicação SaaS utilizando Java, Angular e MySQL
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais e Product Managers para implementar novas funcionalidades
  • Contribuir para decisões arquiteturais e design técnico
  • Participar de cerimônias Agile e fornecer estimativas precisas de desenvolvimento
  • Realizar revisão de código e garantir altos padrões de qualidade


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Java: Mínimo de 12 anos de experiência incluindo JUnit, Hibernate, Spring Frameworks e Gradle
  • Angular: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência utilizando Angular, Tailwind, Jest ou similares
  • Banco de Dados MySQL: Design e otimização de queries, profiling,
  • Serviços AWS: EC2, ECS, RDS, Lambda, etc
  • CI/CD e Testes Automatizados: Expêriencia com BuildKite, Jenkins ou similares


Habilidades Profissionais:

  • Inglês fluente para comunicação e eficaz com equipes técnicas e não técnicas, especialmente em ambientes remotos
  • Colaboração ativa em equipes multifuncionais internacionais
  • Documentação técnica clara e detalhada
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver desafios técnicos


Responsabilidades de Segurança:

  • Aderir à Política de Segurança de TI da empresa
  • Seguir as diretrizes do OWASP Top 10
  • Participar de treinamentos de segurança, conforme necessário


Outros Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade para comunicação dentro do horário mencionado
  • Compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento profissional
  • Alinhamento com os valores da empresa

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Business Analyst to manage and mentor a team of analysts creating business-focused content to improve AI models. You’ll combine leadership, quality oversight, and subject expertise in MBA-relevant domains to ensure outputs are accurate, logically sound, and aligned with project goals. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys people management, operational excellence, and shaping high-quality analytical content. No prior AI experience is required for this role.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts/Content Specialists.
  • Allocate tasks, oversee workflows, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Conduct QA reviews, refine processes, and improve team efficiency.
  • Provide performance feedback, training, and career development.
  • Act as the primary stakeholder contact, sharing regular project updates.
  • Guide creation of case studies, scenarios, and structured business content (finance, policy, e-commerce, etc.).


What We’re Looking For:

  • 2+ years of team management experience.
  • 3–6 years in business analysis, consulting, content, or domain-focused projects.
  • Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior work on LLM performance data, case study writing, or academic/research content.
  • Full-time commitment (40 hrs/week); immediate joiners preferred.


Why Join Us:

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Lead a team working on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. description:

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

● English fluently

Palantir Foundry, Typescript, React JS, Workshop, Pyspark

· • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications

Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.

  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications
  • Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
  • Improve application User Interface and visualization design
  • Implement operational applications using Foundry Tools (Workshop, Quiver, and Slate).
  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Develop writeback functionality into the tool as needed.
  • Implement data visualizations using Foundry Tools (Quiver and Contour) and/or Power BI.
  • Maintain applications as usage grows and requirements change.
  • Develop data pipelines using PySpark to create datasets, Foundry objects, and User Interface applications.
  • Collaborate with the Data Engineering Team to understand the ontology and data pipelines supporting the applications.
  • Support end-to-end data pipeline development using Python and PySpark for ETL processes.
  • Support designing and building high-scale data-intensive workflows.
  • Perform data validations and analysis, using PyTest to create and implement unit tests.
  • Implement Foundry Expectations within Foundry Health checks for automated validations.
  • Monitor and debug critical issues such as data staleness or data quality.
  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label SaaS architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays

We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles



Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Designer digital
description:
A Minha Biblioteca Católica está expandindo sua atuação para o mercado americano com o lançamento do My Catholic Library, clube de assinatura católico nos Estados Unidos.


Para essa nova fase, estamos formando um time dedicado integralmente ao projeto, com profissionais criativos, estratégicos e atentos a detalhes.


O(a) Designer será responsável por criar peças visuais para Instagram, anúncios, e e-mails, garantindo consistência estética, clareza de mensagem e alto padrão visual. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção da identidade da marca e na geração de desejo e conversão no mercado americano.


Se você tem olhar estético apurado, domínio técnico e entende o design como ferramenta estratégica de marca e performance, essa vaga é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:
  • Criar peças de design para Instagram (feed, stories, reels e destaques), alinhadas à estratégia de conteúdo e lançamentos;
  • Desenvolver layouts para anúncios pagos, respeitando formatos e boas práticas de performance;
  • Criar materiais visuais para e-mail marketing;
  • Garantir consistência visual a partir do posicionamento, identidade e diretrizes da marca;
  • Trabalhar a hierarquia visual, tipografia, cores e composição para clareza e conversão;
  • Adaptar peças para diferentes formatos, plataformas e proporções;
  • Interpretar e executar briefings estratégicos, propondo soluções visuais criativas;
  • Realizar ajustes e refinamentos a partir de feedbacks do time;
  • Organizar arquivos, versões e entregas dentro dos prazos definidos;
  • Acompanhar tendências de design digital, especialmente no mercado americano.


Conhecimentos e habilidades:
  • Experiência comprovada como designer gráfico ou digital para marketing e redes sociais;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design (Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign ou similares);
  • Experiência com design para redes sociais, anúncios e páginas digitais;
  • Capacidade de transformar conceitos estratégicos em peças visuais claras e atraentes;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e comprometimento com prazos;
  • Abertura para feedbacks e ajustes contínuos;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (para compreensão de briefings e referências internacionais).

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:


looking for a kind and curious Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving challenging problems. Our awesome team of friendly humans is responsible for making it easy and compelling for individuals to consign items .

We place a strong focus on individual growth and personal development on our collaborative engineering team. As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as a strong influencer for our technical direction.

You will be able to lead and contribute to significant initiatives as well as provide mentorship through code reviews and pairing.

We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience and will be fully remote.

title: Sourcer Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM e Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Copywriter
description:
A Minha Biblioteca Católica está expandindo sua atuação para o mercado americano com o lançamento do My Catholic Library, clube de assinatura católico nos Estados Unidos.


Para essa nova fase internacional, estamos formando um time dedicado integralmente ao projeto, com talentos criativos, estratégicos e alinhados à nossa missão de inspirar a santidade e manifestar os grandes tesouros da fé católica. 


O(a) copywriter será responsável por criar textos estratégicos e criativos para Instagram, e-mails, anúncios e páginas de lançamento, traduzindo a essência da marca para o público americano, com foco em clareza, desejo e conversão.


Se você é uma pessoa criativa, com pensamento estratégico, domínio de copywriting e possui domínio do inglês, essa é a oportunidade ideal para fazer parte de um projeto católico com impacto global.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:
  • Criar copies para Instagram (feed, stories, reels e anúncios), alinhadas à identidade e ao posicionamento do My Catholic Library;
  • Desenvolver e-mails de campanha , fluxos de relacionamento e lançamentos, com foco em engajamento e conversão;
  • Escrever textos para anúncios pagos (Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads), explorando diferentes ângulos, promessas e gatilhos;
  • Criar páginas de lançamento e vendas (landing pages), estruturando narrativa, headline, argumentos e CTA;
  • Desenvolver roteiros e narrativas com foco em conversão, utilizando técnicas de copywriting, storytelling e gatilhos emocionais;
  • Adaptar mensagens para o mercado americano , considerando linguagem, cultura, contexto e comportamento do público;
  • Participar do planejamento de campanhas e lançamentos do My Catholic Library;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências de copywriting, marketing digital e comunicação no mercado dos EUA.


Conhecimentos e habilidades:
  • Experiência comprovada como copywriter, preferencialmente em marketing digital ou e-commerce;
  • Escrita clara, persuasiva e estratégica, com foco em conversão;
  • Experiência com copy para redes sociais, e-mail marketing, anúncios e landing pages;
  • Capacidade de adaptar tom de voz e linguagem para diferentes formatos e públicos;
  • Organização e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas demandas e prazos;
  • Inglês fluente (escrito), essencial para atuação no mercado americano;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade com entregas.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência com lançamentos digitais ou clubes de assinatura;
  • Vivência ou familiaridade com o mercado americano;
  • Familiaridade com a cultura católica e com o universo da Minha Biblioteca Católica.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Cientista de Dados com foco em Machine Learning e IA - SR, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Habilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolvimento backend em Python, com foco em orientação a objetos, boas práticas, criação de classes, funções e APIs.
  • Desenvolvimento de soluções de IA Generativa, Machine Learning e Processamento de Linguagem Natural (PLN), aplicadas principalmente a chatbots.
  • Implementação e utilização de arquiteturas baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Projeto, implantação e otimização de aplicações em ambiente AWS, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e performance.
  • Atuação colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares, contribuindo para o desenho de soluções robustas.
  • Participação em ambientes ágeis, com uso de práticas de CI/CD; experiência com Node.js/TypeScript será considerada um diferencial.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
