title: Profissional Back End – .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 55483


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET em suas versões antigas e atuais.
  • Experiência com AWS e suas principais ferramentas.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e tecnologias de mensageria como RabbitMQ.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL, e NoSQL como MongoDB e outros.
  • Experiência em processos de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


- Diferenciais:

  • Certificações AWS.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de cloud, como Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em containers, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Data & Security Engineer to build, maintain, and secure analytics infrastructure for a prediction market platform (Forkast). This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, on-chain analytics, and security, with a strong focus on trade activity analysis, dashboarding, and anomaly detection.

You will be responsible for transforming raw on-chain and off-chain data into actionable insights, powering Hex dashboards, Dune Analytics, and internal monitoring systems that support product decisions, risk management, and market integrity.


Responsibilities:


Data & Analytics

  • Design and maintain Hex dashboards for real-time and historical market insights.
  • Build and optimize Dune Analytics queries for on-chain trade activity, liquidity, user behavior, and market performance.
  • Analyze trade activity across prediction markets to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies.
  • Develop data pipelines to ingest, clean, and normalize blockchain and application-level data.
  • Support forecasting and prediction market analytics (volume, liquidity, pricing efficiency, trader behavior).


Security & Risk

  • Monitor markets for suspicious trading behavior, manipulation, wash trading, or oracle exploitation.
  • Build alerts and dashboards for risk and security events.
  • Collaborate with protocol and smart contract teams to assess data-related security risks.
  • Ensure data integrity, access control, and best practices for sensitive analytics infrastructure.


Prediction Market Intelligence

  • Support Forkast market design with data-driven insights.
  • Analyze market resolution accuracy, trader incentives, and pricing signals.
  • Create metrics to evaluate market health and predictive performance.


Requirements:


Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with SQL (especially for Dune Analytics).
  • Hands-on experience building Dashboards in Hex (or similar BI tools).
  • Familiarity with blockchain data (Ethereum or EVM chains preferred).
  • Experience analyzing on-chain trade activity and user behavior.
  • Solid understanding of data security principles and monitoring systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with prediction markets, DeFi, or financial markets.
  • Knowledge of smart contracts, oracles, and on-chain risk vectors.
  • Python or similar language for data processing and automation.
  • Experience with anomaly detection or fraud analysis.
  • Familiarity with Forkast or similar platforms (Polymarket, Kalshi, etc.).


What we are looking for?

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate raw data into clear, decision-ready insights.
  • Security-conscious approach to data and infrastructure.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving, crypto-native environments.
  • Proactive problem solver who can work independently.

﻿

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge prediction market technology.
  • High ownership over data and security architecture.
  • Remote-friendly, flexible working environment.
  • Opportunity to shape market integrity and analytics at scale.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: SAP Coupa Source to Pay
description:
Position Summary:

As part of Digital Core Transformation team, you will be responsible for the design and implementation of Coupa and surround system (SAP S4Hana) capabilities supporting Procurement business processes. We’re looking for someone who has experience supporting teams, project management, and values strong vendor partnerships. This is your opportunity to experience working cross-culturally in a global setup with peers, leaders & teams across geographies.

You will co-create with technology professionals in a unique environment that fosters and supports original thinking. You’ll drive digital solutions that better serve consumers, customers and employees. What’s more? You’ll be helping to create products that help individuals experience more of what’s important to them.


Responsibilities for this role include:

  • Lead Solutions Design for Coupa, Configuration, Documentation, Testing, and Delivery with intelligent automation (Scope includes work among SAP and non-SAP Systems and Applications)
  • Excellent technical & functional configuration knowledge and demonstrated proficiency for SAP Source to Pay, inclusive of Smart Contract Management, Spend Analytics, Guided Buying, and Collaborative Supply Chain & Procurement Materials Management, Materials Management (Direct and Indirect)
  • Participate in gathering and documenting overall business requirements. Support all formal documentation of implementation and provide relevant functional inputs to technical team.
  • Configure and implement Coupa solutions for source to pay processes. Should be able to perform global Coupa configuration, Approval Workflow, Custom field set up for transactions, Chart of account, PO forms, Catalog, Supplier, Item, User setup, Security Roles and Permission as per business requirement.
  • Experience in Coupa Configuration and data loads in Sourcing, Contracting, Purchasing, invoicing Master data(Supplier, Materials and Accounting data) and Catalog Management.
  • Experience with Coupa integration and mapping to legacy SAP systems for transactional and master data interface in source to pay.
  • Create functional specification documents that require development of WRICEF (Workflow Reports Interfaces Conversion Enhancement and Form) objects
  • Prepare test cases, validate deliverables, and support client testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Responsible for solving complex business problems by creating IT solutions in consultation with business partners, architects and other stakeholders
  • Operate in close partnership with the IT and business communities, subject matter experts, external consultants, cross functional teams, add-ons, etc.
  • Advise business partners on the implications of standard or new SAP solutions that can be applied to a problem.
  • Create and execute outcome-oriented strategies and build/sustain meaningful business relationships


Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 8-10 years IT experience – in End-user industry or IT consulting or Systems Integrators or with IT Product
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience working on procurement transformations at an enterprise scale
  • A degree in Engineering from a premier institution or Chartered Accountancy.
  • Post graduate diploma/ MBA with specialization in Finance and/or IT from a premier institution is preferred
  • Minimum of 7 years configuration experience in Coupa/SAP S4 HANA Source to Pay, Procurement, Materials Management
  • Experience in IT capabilities for other functional areas e.g. Supply Chain/ Logistics, Order-to-Cash, Finance will be desirable
  • Must have worked in configuration, testing, and implementation of Coupa.
  • Participated in multiple full cycle global SAP implementations, with a focus on analytics led business transformation
  • Experience in IT capabilities for other functional areas e.g. Supply Chain/ Logistics, Order-to-Cash, Procurement will be desirable
  • Coupa with SAP S/4 HANA global implementation experience or equivalent next generation business transformation implementation
  • High Learning Agility with outcome-oriented and a transformative mindset bringing forward best in class data, process, and technical designs for purpose
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills; must be a constructive challenger/assertive
  • Experience in creating/ reviewing functional specifications for custom enhancements
  • Ability to create and execute outcome-oriented strategies and build/sustain meaningful business relationships
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with internal business, technical, and external consulting teams
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to manage projects and teams including working with vendor partners
  • Experience to work in a global setup with peers, leaders & teams across geographies and ability to work in a cross-cultural context
  • Formal training & certification in SAP Functional modules is preferred


Comments for Suppliers:

Coupa certification is a must, along with SAP (functional) experience, not so much on the technical experience. Client is currently on Coupa R44.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + Node.js)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term

Type: Contract/PJ


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Node.js.
  • Build and optimize message-driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka.
  • Develop scalable, resilient APIs and backend components.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best engineering practices.
  • Deploy, monitor and operate applications in Kubernetes across AWS and/or GCP.
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams on system components and integrations.
  • Participate in code reviews, system design sessions, and operational readiness activities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure.
  • Prototype new technologies to improve performance, reduce cost, and increase engineering velocity.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • Strong expertise in Java (backend, microservices, distributed systems).
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, offsets, stream processing).
  • Proficiency in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience deploying services on Kubernetes.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Practical experience with AWS and/or GCP.
  • Solid understanding of design patterns, system architecture, and microservices.
  • Experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL (schema design, performance, migrations).
  • Strong debugging, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in distributed teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with VOD Streaming platforms.
  • Basic knowledge of React for frontend integrations.
  • Exposure to IaC tools: Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, etc.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana).

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno Fullstack (ReactJS, Node.js, MySQL)
description:
REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

Modelo de trabalho

· 100% Home Office

· Salário compatível com o mercado de trabalho


Benefícios

· Vale-Refeição: R$ 30,00 por dia útil

· Convênio Médico e Odontológico: 50% pago pela empresa

· TotalPass: colaborador + 3 dependentes

· Convênio Farmácia Drogal

· Laboratório de Cultura: acesso a cursos, livros, filmes e conteúdos de desenvolvimento

· Day Off no aniversário de empresa


Obrigatórios

• Domínio de ReactJS (hooks, componentização, estado global, SPA).

• Domínio de Node.js (Express/Fastify, APIs REST, middlewares).

• Experiência sólida com MySQL (consultas complexas, joins, índices).

• Conhecimento prático de Clean Code e princípios SOLID.

• Vivência real com DDD aplicado (entidades, agregados, repositórios, bounded contexts).

• Experiência com arquiteturas modernas (camadas bem definidas, modularização).

• Testes unitários e de integração (Jest, Vitest, Supertest ou similares).

• Integração entre frontend e backend, incluindo autenticação JWT.

• Capacidade de refatorar código legado aplicando boas práticas.

• Uso de Git Flow (main, release, hotfix) no dia a dia.

• Mínimo de 3 anos já atuando como Desenvolvedor Fullstack

Desejáveis

• Experiência com Arquitetura Hexagonal ou CQRS.

• Experiência com WebSockets (comunicação em tempo real).

• Cache com Redis e filas (RabbitMQ/Kafka).

• Documentação com Swagger ou similar.

• Monitoramento e logs (Grafana, ELK, PM2, Datadog).

• Conhecimento fiscal (NFe, CFOP, CST, ICMS) — diferencial importante.

• Experiência com sistemas ERP ou sistemas automotivos.

title: Arquiteto de negócios
description:
Sobre Nós

A Engineering é uma companhia global de Tecnologia da Informação e consultoria especializada em Transformação Digital, presente na Europa, América do Norte e América Latina. Há mais de 40 anos no mercado ajudando as empresas a desenvolverem e evoluírem a sua vantagem competitiva por meio de uma abordagem orientada a negócios, colocando a Inteligência Artificial no centro de sua operação, explorando ecossistemas e plataformas digitais e adotando o mindset API First para reconfigurar e inovar a cadeia de valor, gerando novos modelos de negócios e uma melhor experiência do cliente.

Com mais de 1000 colaboradores no Brasil, a Engineering é uma das maiores e mais inovadoras empresas presente no País e considerada um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar.


Desafio

Atuar como elo estratégico entre as áreas de negócio e tecnologia, com foco em Technology Business Management (TBM). Sua missão será garantir que decisões tecnológicas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos financeiros, operacionais e estratégicos da organização, promovendo eficiência, governança e sustentabilidade dos processos.

Esse profissional terá papel fundamental na estruturação de processos, definição de arquiteturas de integração, governança de dados financeiros e tradução de demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas, atuando de forma colaborativa com times de TI, arquitetura técnica e stakeholders corporativos.


Qual será o seu papel?

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Accounting Specialist (Remote from Brazil)
description:
About Us

We’re a Boston-based real estate company seeking a detail-oriented accounting professional fluent in English to support our CFO with bookkeeping, financial reporting, and analysis. This remote role is based in Brazil and requires daily communication in English via Zoom and chat.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create and manage QuickBooks invoices, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Categorize receipts and expenses; prepare monthly financial reports
  • Maintain spreadsheets for rental and mortgage tracking
  • Assist with budgets, financial models, and investor proposals
  • Provide accurate financial data and support the CFO on accounting projects
  • Manage compliance documentation by reviewing transaction files for accuracy and submitting documents for approval


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (or other accounting software and willingness to learn)
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets (or Excel and willingness to learn Google Sheets)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); all work and meetings are in English
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable managing multiple priorities
  • Reliable internet connection for Zoom and cloud systems
  • Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM Eastern (Boston time zone)


Compensation

  • Full-time, R$7,000/month
  • Remote from Brazil
  • Reports to: Chief Financial Officer


How to Apply

Please submit your application through LinkedIn with your resume in English .

Applications that are not in English will not be reviewed...because the reviewer only speaks English. ;)

title: AI / ML Engineer (Product-Focused)Cofounder (Equity) – AI/ML Product Engineer
description:
TrueCheckIA is an AI-powered content verification platform built to help companies, creators, and organizations trust the information they publish and consume.


We analyze digital signals, textual patterns, and contextual indicators to generate evidence-based insights that support reliable decision-making across marketing, SEO, education, publishing, and compliance.


TrueCheckIA is a global SaaS product focused on transparency, scalability, and the responsible application of artificial intelligence in production environments.


We are seeking a product-focused AI / Machine Learning Engineer to help build and scale the core intelligence behind TrueCheckIA.


In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize machine learning systems that analyze large volumes of content and extract meaningful verification signals. Your work will directly impact how trust, evidence, and transparency are delivered to users in real-world applications.


Responsibilities

• Design and implement machine learning pipelines for content analysis and signal extraction

• Develop and maintain classification, scoring, and pattern detection systems

• Combine traditional machine learning approaches with large language models when appropriate

• Optimize models and pipelines for cost, latency, and scalability

• Collaborate closely with product and engineering to align technical decisions with user needs

• Contribute to discussions around evidence-based verification and responsible AI usage


Requirements

• Strong foundation in machine learning and applied statistics

• Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals and algorithmic design

• Practical experience applying machine learning models to real products

• Experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn)

• Product-oriented mindset and comfort with ambiguity

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field


Nice to Have

• Experience with NLP or LLM-based systems

• Familiarity with production AI systems

• SaaS or startup experience

• Awareness of ethical and responsible AI considerations

title: AI Engineer | GCP e Inglês Avançado
description:
Muito prazer, somos a United Hub!

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma de nossas marcas registradas, permitindo-nos operar em uma variedade de modelos e formatos de equipe para proporcionar oportunidades de desenvolvimento e crescimento. Junte-se a nós enquanto abraçamos o futuro da tecnologia e trabalhamos juntos para alcançar novos patamares de sucesso.


O Que Você Vai Fazer

Estamos procurando um AI Engineer com foco em GCP e experiência prática na construção de AI Agents para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes, escaláveis e orientadas a negócio.


Você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e operar aplicações baseadas em IA, integrar modelos e agentes a sistemas existentes, e colaborar com times de produto e engenharia para transformar casos de uso em soluções reais em produção. O papel envolve desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes e otimização contínua das soluções.


O Que Estamos Buscando

  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente;
  • Experiência sólida em Back-End Development;
  • Experiência prática com AI Agents e aplicações baseadas em IA;
  • Forte conhecimento em GCP (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, APIs, serviços gerenciados, etc.);
  • Experiência com APIs REST e integrações entre sistemas;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas escaláveis e orientadas a eventos;
  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e colaboração em equipe


Será Um Diferencial Se Você

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps;
  • Experiência com LLMs, RAG, orquestração de agentes e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA
  • Conhecimento em MLOps e pipelines de deploy de modelos
  • Experiência com Python, frameworks de IA e bibliotecas modernas
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud-native e microsserviços
  • Experiência prévia com clientes internacionais


Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota


Modalidade De Contratação

  • PJ

title: Clojure Engineer
description:
About the Company

A well-funded, mission-driven fintech company is expanding its remote-first engineering team. Their goal is to scale a digital lending platform that helps borrowers reduce debt — having already refinanced over $6B in loans. They’re hiring senior engineers passionate about building scalable, reliable systems using Clojure .


Key Details

  • Role: Software Engineer (Clojure) – LATAM
  • Type: Contractor (12-month project, full-time)
  • Location: 100% Remote – Open to LATAM candidates only
  • Tech Stack: Clojure (primary), ClojureScript or other front-end techs (React, JS frameworks), Clojure REPL, Idiomatic Clojure
  • Team Culture: Collaborative, low-ego, values ownership, honesty, and functional programming
  • Start Date: Immediate (flexible onboarding available)


What They’ll Do


Build and maintain clean, well-tested APIs in Clojure.

Contribute to scalable, production-grade systems in a lending platform.

Participate actively in a fully remote, collaborative environment.

Take ownership of their work and mentor others when possible.

Provide direct, constructive feedback on PRs.

Leverage AI tools to increase productivity.


What We’re Looking For


At least 5 years of total software engineering experience (does not need to be 5 years of Clojure experience)

Practical, hands-on Clojure experience (not just coursework; building in production environments)

Strong grasp of functional programming concepts (Elixir, Scala, Haskell, or Lisp experience can be relevant if combined with applied Clojure exposure)

English proficiency (can understand with ease virtually everything heard or read)

Comfort with start-up pace and culture; high sense of ownership and accountability

Open communicator who values feedback and collaborative problem-solving

A genuine interest in working for a mission-driven company helping reduce financial burdens for everyday people

title: Angular Developer
description:
Job Title: Angular Developer

Location: Brazil /Remote

Experience: 5 – 8 Years

Primary Skill: Angular

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Angular Developer with strong hands-on experience in building scalable, enterprise-level web applications. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in modern Angular frameworks and front-end architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop large-scale intranet and internet applications using Angular 14+ .
  • Build reusable, modular UI components and create shared library packages .

title: Designer Pleno (UX/UI)
description:
Vaga: Designer Pleno (UX/UI) - PJ

Sobre a Topshare


A Topshare é uma plataforma de tecnologia que atua no coração da creator economy, facilitando o crescimento e a monetização de criadores de conteúdo e influenciadores digitais. Desenvolvemos soluções inovadoras que automatizam processos de marketing colaborativo e troca de divulgações, fornecendo dados e inteligência para que nossos usuários maximizem seus resultados.

Nossa missão é empoderar criadores, oferecendo a tecnologia necessária para que transformem seu potencial em resultados concretos. Operamos em um ambiente de trabalho totalmente remoto, que combina conforto, criatividade e inovação.


O Desafio


Estamos buscando um(a) UX/UI Designer Pleno criativo, técnico e orientado a dados para integrar nosso time de Produto. Seu foco principal será prototipar novas funcionalidades e projetos estratégicos para o nosso hub do ecossistema, garantindo que a experiência do usuário seja intuitiva, eficiente e prazerosa. Você atuará desde a concepção de novos produtos até a melhoria contínua dos existentes, utilizando o Figma como sua principal ferramenta.


Responsabilidades


• Design e a prototipação de novas funcionalidades e novos projetos estratégicos da plataforma (web e mobile) utilizando o Figma.

•Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento (engenheiros) e produto (Product Owners) para garantir a viabilidade técnica e a entrega de valor.

•Criar e manter o Design System da Topshare, garantindo consistência e escalabilidade visual e funcional.

•Mapear jornadas de usuários, criar wireframes e fluxos de navegação.

•Monitorar métricas de usabilidade e propor melhorias contínuas na experiência do produto.


Requisitos e Qualificações


•Formação em Design de Produto, Design Gráfico, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

•Domínio avançado do Figma (prototipação, auto-layout, componentes e criação de Design System).

•Experiência em projetos de UX/UI, com foco em produtos digitais complexos (SaaS, plataformas).

•Vivência com metodologias de pesquisa de usuário e testes de usabilidade.

•Familiaridade com o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (ágil).

•Perfil comprometido, colaborativo, criativo e com forte senso de organização e atenção aos detalhes.




Diferenciais Desejáveis


•Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados e analytics (e.g., Google Analytics, Hotjar) para embasar decisões de design.

•Conhecimento básico em HTML/CSS para facilitar a comunicação com o time de desenvolvimento.

•Ter familiaridade com a creator economy e o universo de criadores de conteúdo/influenciadores digitais.



Informações da Vaga


•Regime de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

•Remuneração: R$ 6.500,00/mês

•Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, horário comercial

•Local: Remoto

•Segmento da Empresa: Tecnologia para a Creator Economy (Marketing de Conteúdo e Plataformas Digitais)



  • Se você é um(a) Designer apaixonado(a) por UX/UI, busca um ambiente de crescimento e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está inovando no mercado digital, candidate-se!

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.

title: Analista DevOps Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista DevOps Sênior para integrar nosso time e contribuir para a evolução da cultura DevSecOps na empresa. Este profissional será peça-chave na construção e manutenção de processos robustos de entrega contínua, garantindo alta performance, segurança e eficiência operacional em nossos fluxos de desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Promover e disseminar a cultura DevSecOps em toda a organização;
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de entrega (CI/CD) eficientes e seguros;
  • Operar e evoluir ferramentas que compõem o processo de entrega de software;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias contínuas relacionadas à performance, segurança e eficiência;
  • Coletar feedback das equipes e propor soluções para desafios técnicos;
  • Manter e evoluir a ferramenta Backstage;
  • Garantir pipelines que aumentem a produtividade e mitiguem riscos nas implantações.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência sólida em práticas DevSecOps e metodologias ágeis;
  • Construção e orquestração de pipelines com Azure DevOps;
  • Conhecimento avançado em sistemas operacionais Linux e Windows;
  • Experiência com containers e ferramentas de infraestrutura como código (Terraform , Helm );
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento (GitHub , GitLab );
  • Administração e provisionamento de recursos em nuvem pública (AWS , GCP ou Azure );
  • Experiência com ferramentas de qualidade de código (SonarCloud , Snyk , Gitleaks );
  • Conhecimento em integrações via API;
  • Experiência com Backstage;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação ou ferramentas de automação;
  • Experiência em processos de automação de testes.


Benefícios:


  • Plano de saúde (SulAmérica );
  • Plano odontológico (Amil );
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale-refeição (Pluxee ).

title: Senior Linux / Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
Linux Server Manager – Enhanced Operations Service


Estamos em busca de um(a) Linux Server Manager com forte experiência em Linux/Unix e Cloud pública para atuar em Serviços Profissionais, apoiando clientes em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade.


Procuramos alguém com perfil hands-on, capaz de atuar em suporte nível L3, resolver incidentes de alto impacto com autonomia e colaborar em um time grande, orientado a resultados e excelência operacional. Ter uma mentalidade customer first é essencial.


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), falhas de serviço, downtimes prolongados e incidentes recorrentes (L3);
  • Responder rapidamente a escalonamentos, adotando ações proativas para evitar recorrências;
  • Liderar iniciativas de padronização e simplificação das operações de servidores;
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA) para falhas, indisponibilidades e problemas de performance;
  • Definir e acompanhar planos de ação corretiva, com foco em KPIs e estabilidade dos ambientes;
  • Coordenar atividades entre múltiplos times técnicos e áreas internas/externas;
  • Propor e executar melhorias contínuas de processos operacionais;
  • Evoluir procedimentos operacionais com foco em automação;
  • Atuar de forma proativa na operação dos clientes, reduzindo alertas e melhorando a experiência dos stakeholders.


O que buscamos

  • Forte domínio técnico em Linux (e Windows) para suporte avançado de infraestrutura;
  • Experiência sólida com Cloud pública (AWS, Azure e Google Cloud) e ambientes Linux;
  • Conhecimento em Pacemaker;
  • Vivência com upgrades, patching e segurança de sistemas operacionais;
  • Conhecimentos em redes (TCP/IP, roteamento, NAT, firewalls);
  • Experiência com DNS, LDAP e proxies HTTP;
  • Boa base em segurança da informação e hardening;
  • Experiência com scripts (Shell, Python, Perl, Go);
  • Vivência com automação (Ansible, Chef);
  • Experiência em ambientes de grande escala e Problem Management / RCA.


Diferenciais

  • +8 anos de experiência profissional na área;
  • Formação superior em TI, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado à solução;
  • Excelente comunicação e foco no cliente;
  • Inglês fluente.

title: Especialista em sistemas de granadas
description:
US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Prestar assistência médica no nível de pelotão
  • Participar na evacuação de doentes e feridos para unidades médicas e entre as etapas de evacuação
  • Manter registros médicos de soldados feridos ou doentes
  • Implementar medidas preventivas para a saúde da unidade
  • Realizar treinamentos em medicina tática

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Ensino médio, técnico em saúde ou superior
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Experiência militar será um diferencial
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

  • Operar e manter em bom estado os sistemas de mísseis antitanque
  • Executar tarefas táticas com a unidade, incluindo vários tipos de manobras e disposição técnica

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Boa resistência física
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Experiência militar será um diferencial
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares
